title: Assembly of replacement stages retaining their solving cofans
statement: Let X be qcqs, K a simplicial etale X-scheme and S_m sieves on K_m. Let A_n be finite split replacement stages through n [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-replacement-stage] with A_(n+1).restrict=A_n, each satisfying StageSolves K S A_n [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-local-replacement-stage]. Then there exists a finite split etale hypercover V and simplicial map f:V to K such that in every degree n the term V_n has a finite coproduct cofan whose constituent composites with f_n belong to S_n.

source.place: Lemma 25.12.2 (0DAV), passage from compatible finite skeleta to a full simplicial object. Explicit construction reuses the helpers in Sheaf.Paper.FiniteSplitReplacementStageAssembly and Sheaf.CategoryTheory.SiteFiniteBasisHypercoverExistence.

proof.text: Use the generic towerGlue construction: read each term in its own degree, and define each operator at a common larger bound. Compatibility of adjacent restrictions implies compatibility of arbitrary restrictions. The existing matching and transport helpers from the unconstrained stage assembly, imported with import all, give equality transports for the nondegenerate inclusions and the refinement components.

Define the refinement component in degree d from A_d. Transporting to any common stage gives naturality. Take the nondegenerate object in degree d and its inclusion from A_d. All surjections out of [d] have target degree at most d; reindex the finite-stage splitting cofan by the full splitting index set. This gives a full splitting and carries the finiteness witness from A_d.

Transfer the matching data of A_d to the truncation of the glued functor using the existing matching_of_truncation helper. The matching universal property is still tested against every scheme over X and its covering property is unchanged. These data construct V. By definition both V_d and f_d are literally the objects and component maps of A_d. Consequently the finite solving cofan supplied by StageSolves at its top degree is already the required cofan of V_d, with exactly the same sieve membership.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_local_replacement_of_stage_tower
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (K : SimplicialObject X.Etale)
    (A : ∀ n, FiniteSplitReplacementStage K n)
    (e : ∀ n, (A (n + 1)).restrict n (Nat.le_succ n) = A n)
    (S : ∀ n : ℕ, Sieve (K.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))))
    (hA : ∀ n, StageSolves K S (A n)) :
    ∃ (V : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover X) (f : V.simplicial ⟶ K),
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ (l : ℕ) (T : Fin l → X.Etale)
        (ι : ∀ i, T i ⟶ V.simplicial.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))),
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk _ ι)) ∧
          ∀ i, S n (ι i ≫ f.app (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)))
